{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # shift each 1 one cell toward the center of its divider-defined compartment
    rows=[i for i in range(h) if 2 in grid[i]]
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if any(grid[i][j]==2 for i in range(h))]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]!=1: continue
            rb=max([x for x in rows if x<r],default=-1); rt=min([x for x in rows if x>r],default=h)
            cb=max([x for x in cols if x<c],default=-1); ct=min([x for x in cols if x>c],default=w)
            nr=r+(1 if r < (rb+rt-1)/2 else -1 if r > (rb+rt-1)/2 else 0)
            nc=c+(1 if c < (cb+ct-1)/2 else -1 if c > (cb+ct-1)/2 else 0)
            if grid[nr][nc]!=2:
                out[r][c]=0; out[nr][nc]=1
    return out"}
